name: Mengdeng Ciye
source:
A young Illuminator who resides in Rosecrown Beacon, the little sister of Mildia Dream and partner of Alina Nightsong. She relies heavily on her sister but is not aware of it herself.

She works hard to pass the Arboranger test to fight Darkritters.

[spoiler]In reality, Fancia is actually a member of the Light Pollution and holds the position of vice leader, opposing the Arborangers.[/spoiler]
